name: Betting-Against-Correlation Tilt
description: Long-only tilt toward the assets with the lowest average pairwise correlation to the rest of the universe (Asness, Frazzini, Gormsen & Pedersen 2020). Isolates the correlation component of the low-risk premium and maximises diversification. Ranks ascending and equal-weights the bottom N. Distinct from LowBetaTilt (full beta), LowVolatilityTilt (vol) and FAA (correlation as one blended factor).
